remarks: GLENBROOK INVESTORS-TAKE NOTICE!This fully occupied three-family home is primed for its next owner. This three-unit property has the ability to produce strong cash flow today with outstanding upside for future growth. All three units have been beautifully renovated. Unit 1 and Unit 2 each feature spacious 3-bedroom, 1-bath layouts that live much larger than expected, while Unit 3 offers an oversized 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence. The first-floor unit showcases gleaming hardwood floors, an updated bathroom, and abundant natural light. The second-floor unit has been freshly painted and updated with new wall-to-wall carpeting. Shared outdoor amenities include an inviting patio and a large level green space. The property also features a full basement with ample storage and coin-operated laundry for added income. Additional highlights include three electric meters, three gas meters, and a huge detached two-car garage with rental potential. Ideally tucked away on a quiet street just .3 miles from the Glenbrook train station, and moments from neighborhood favorites like Hope Street Pizza and Donut Delight, this property offers tenants effortless access to Stamford's dining, nightlife, shopping, parks, and vibrant cultural scene. This is the investment opportunity you've been waiting for.
